important_files.agent.py: LiveKit AgentServer entry point; hardcodes Gemini Realtime model/voice/temperature; Assistant.tools list is the single source of truth for which tools are voice-callable
important_files.nova_bridge.py: Atomic file-based inbox/outbox/heartbeat (CommandStore) shared between Dashboard and agent processes; validates command envelopes, never transports secrets or code
important_files.nova_agent_bridge.py: Runs inside the live agent process; polls nova_bridge, injects delegated text turns via session.generate_reply, resolves approve/deny via nova_policy.permission_engine
important_files.nova_startup.py: Standalone standby supervisor; starts nova_guardian + nova_integrations; not imported by or dependent on agent.py
important_files.tools/__init__.py: Central re-export surface for all 38 function-tool modules; agent.py must import AND separately list each tool for it to be voice-callable
important_files.tools/specialist.py: ask_specialist tool wrapping nova_core.ModelRouter; imported but not registered in agent.py's tool list
important_files.Dashboard/server.py: aiohttp backend, binds 127.0.0.1 only, /ws WebSocket hub + /health + static asset serving, 12 background collector loops
Tauri v2 config; frontendDist points at Dashboard/web (shared with server.py), NSIS bundle target, CSP disabled
important_files.nova_core/router.py: ModelRouter: candidate-provider selection, cloud-budget gating, fallback ordering
important_files.nova_policy/engine.py: PermissionEngine / ActionPolicy / PermissionLevel — central approval gate used by tools/permissions.py, tools/email_calendar.py, nova_agent_bridge.py
